notes.title: v1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Here are the update details:

1. Increased Collection Robot quantity with new limit of 40 units.
2. Increased Production Robot quantity with new limit of 70 units.
3. Increased gathering capacity from 10 to 15 Collection Robot per mineral type.
4. Added toggle option for machine production visual effects.
5. Added Honor and Overflow Factor exchange functionality at the Shrine.
6. Added Overflow Accelerator management system to control individual machine type speeds.
7. Standardized daily refresh rates across all shop items.
8. Added bathing time display.
9. Adjusted Chamber Quest upgrade experience requirements.
10. Adjusted Chamber Quest rewards.
11. Adjusted selling prices for items crafted by Commodity Fabricator.
12. Fixed incorrect description for 4-slot Transfer Box.
13. Fixed an issue when placing more than 999 items in Storage Boxes.
14. Fixed an issue where Aluminium ingot limit couldn’t exceed 999.
15. Improved Gathering machanics: low-tier seed drops now replaced with unlocked seed varieties.
16. Accelerated food preparation speed at Manual Cooking Stove.
17. Improved fishing mechanics and values.

Your are welcomed to join our Discord (2pgames.net/discord) and leave your feedback on Sim-n-Management channel.

notes.title: V1.0.9 Update -Fishing Enhancements, Trading Posts &Performance Improvements!
notes.content:
Here are the update details:

1. Enhanced fishing system.
2. Streamlined furniture controls to match building interface.
3. Added player statistics display in settings menu.
4. Added 9-slot Transit Box to Technology Tree.
5. Added Trading Post to Technology Tree.
6. Added middle mouse wheel zooming in farm areas.
7. Added "deposit similar items" function to boxes.
8. Automatic Cooking Stove will now fetch materials from house boxes automatically (one stack at a time).
9. Added resource calculator displaying consumption and production rates based on existing machines.
10. Added plant maturity timers when hovering with cursor.
11. Increased item stack limit from 999 to 9999.
12. Fixed an issue where dungeon portals weren't disappearing properly.
13. Fixed an issue where Teleport Stones couldn't be used after boss defeats.
14. Improved stamina recovery mechanics.
15. Adjusted market values for various fruits.

Your are welcomed to join our Discord (2pgames.net/discord) and leave your feedback on Sim-n-Management channel.

Portal stone that allows you to teleport at any place on the main map can now be acquired with the AI in the UFO

notes.title: Faun Town is Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!
 
FaunTown is officially released on April 17th at 10:00 AM (CST)! The game is priced at 10.99USD, and you can enjoy a 15% off special discount during the first week.
 
Faun Town is an automation X farming simulation game. After your spaceship crash-lands on a remote island, leaving you with amnesia, you must utilize all the island's resources to build automated production lines and repair your vessel. While recovering your memories, you'll not only uncover the secrets of the small town but also learn the shocking truth about this world.
 
[h2]Gather Resources, Build Your Spaceship[/h2]
 
To recover your lost memories, you'll need to start from scratch, gathering various mineral resources for production and processing. But you don't have to do everything yourself! From mining and farming to transporting and redistributing various components, robots can handle it all. You just need to plan the resource production ratios effectively to ensure the entire automated production process runs smoothly. Repair your spaceship with the help of automated robots and uncover the truth behind the accident.
 
[h2]Cultivate Plants and Explore the Island Depths[/h2]
 
Deep within the island where Faun Town is located lie many secrets, guarded by numerous monsters. As you progress in repairing your spaceship, you'll unlock the combat system. By extracting and modifying DNA from crops, you can create alien plants capable of adapting to the wild and possessing powerful combat abilities. Use these plants to battle beasts – even giant mutated ones can be easily defeated.
 
[h2]Enjoy Town Life or Uncover Villager Stories[/h2]
 
The people of Shepherd Town have lived here for generations. You can blend in, befriend the various villagers, share drinks with them at the bar, and enjoy a unique life on this isolated island. However, while enjoying life, you might discover various conflicts simmering among the islanders. Fragments of information seem to point towards a mysterious organization. In the deepest parts of the island, there are even ruins and dungeons filled with an eerie atmosphere. Can you uncover the truth behind it all?
 
If you encounter any bugs or need further assistance during gameplay, please join our Discord (2pgames.net/discord) to leave your feedback.

notes.title: Join us in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear doctors,

Thank you for your continued support and attention to the game! We’re thrilled to announce the participation of Faun Town in the Steam Next Festival from February 24th to March 3rd at 10:00 am PT. Simulation management enthusiasts are welcome to participate in the demo!

Prepare to raise your technology levels, build automated processes, improve production efficiency, and develop your own farm. The game also includes strategic tower defense gameplay – explore towers with different functions and change their locations to enjoy hearty battles. Come and experience the game yourself!

In addition, multiple developer live broadcasts will be held during the Next Fest to facilitate watching and playing, allow you to experience real game scenes, and enhance the sense of immersion!

If you encounter any problems while playing the demo, you are welcome to join our Discord to share your game experience and suggestions with us. Let’s build Faun Town together!
